sub: WordPress 7.1.5 is a security release, and WordPress recommends updating right away.

slides.title: What changed
slides.body:
WordPress released version 7.1.5 on Nov 18 with fixes for multiple security issues.
Security fixes were also backported to older versions that still get them.
slides.tip: Sites with automatic background updates start updating on their own.

slides.title: Who it affects
slides.body:
Any business or organization whose website runs on WordPress.
That includes sites built with Elementor, which runs on WordPress.

slides.title: What to do this week
slides.body:
Log in to your WordPress dashboard and open Updates.
Confirm the site shows 7.1.5, or back it up and update now.
slides.tip: After updating, test your contact form and checkout.

cta.head: Questions about this change?
cta.sub: Not sure who updates your website? Start there.
